scenes.title: Red River Valley
scenes.subtitle: A campfire classic.
lines: This lesson teaches the A campfire classic 'Red River Valley' — a simple, fingerstyle melody that's perfect for beginners.
The chords are G, D and C.
Each bar has four beats, and the song plays at 90 beats per minute.
You're all set to play 'Red River Valley.' Grab your guitar, sing along, and let the app listen through the microphone as you play.
